blocking_findings: Net-debt basis mislabel / anchor conflict: valuation/01, earnings/99, and decision_record.json all label $9,340mm as the 'strict' net-debt basis, but that figure nets in $521mm of short-term investments and is therefore the BROAD basis per CLAUDE.md §15's own definition (total debt − cash & equivalents ONLY). balance-sheet-survival/01 correctly computes the true strict figure as $9,861mm and correctly labels $9,340mm as broad — so the 'strict' tag carries two different values ($9,340mm vs $9,861mm) across modules for the same period. The headline EV bridge and all three scenario fair-value levels ($104.89/$74.91/$40.23) rest on the mislabeled $9,340mm figure. Dollar impact is small (~$0.25/share, <0.4% of EV) and does not change the Watchlist decision, but it is a required §15 hygiene/anchor-conflict flag.

The committed final_thesis.md carries an explicit, unresolved 'PROVISIONAL — the automated finish-gate found an integrity issue; this thesis was committed UNVERIFIED' banner: a live 'Playground' recompute of the base and bear_cyclical scenario fair-value levels disagrees with the frozen levels (base +0.70% drift, bear_cyclical +1.29% drift), and the Headline Scorecard's sizing text does not literally match decision_record.json's sizing_hint.action. The run was committed to the ledger despite failing its own automated release gate, and the discrepancy remains unresolved in the artifacts audited here.
